question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Reluctant
solution:
The correct answer is '**Option 2'** i.e.** 'Willing'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** "Reluctant" **in English means unwilling and hesitant; disinclined (अनिच्छुक).
 
• **Example: **He was reluctant to share his personal information with strangers
 
• The word **"Willing"** is an antonym of "Reluctant", meaning ready, eager, or prepared to do something (इच्छुक).
 
• **Example:** She was always willing to help those in need.

Therefore, the** correct answer** is - **'Willing'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'Cautious'** (Option 1) means careful to avoid potential problems or dangers (सतर्क).
 
• **'Resistant' **(Option 3) similar to reluctant, it means opposed to something and trying to prevent it from happening (प्रतिरोधी).
 
• **'Miserable' **(Option 4) means very unhappy; wretched (दुखी).
